text:
maria: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's GPU OOM storm. We surfaced three recurring patterns: noisy transient OOMs from batch jobs, duplicate alerts across regions, and inconsistent paging thresholds for infra vs. product teams. I sketched action items below — can owners confirm timelines?

aj: I can own the dedupe rules. Plan: roll a rule set that groups GPU OOMs by job_id + model_family and suppress duplicates for 5m. Target: EOW (Fri). :hammer:

liam: I’ll take the threshold tuning for product-facing pages. Current alert floods when tail latencies hit 95th pct spikes during model deployments. Proposal: raise hard page threshold from 500ms -> 800ms for non-prod routes, keep 500ms for prod. Need to validate impact with a 48h A/B.

sophia: I'll pair with Liam on validating A/B. Also can add a quick histogram dashboard to check spike distribution. ETA next Wed for dashboard. :eyes:

maria: Thanks. For dedupe, please include a fallback to region-level alerts in case grouping hides true cross-region failures. We don't want single-point failures to be silent.

aj: noted — fallback to region if >25% of nodes in that region fail in 10m. I'll add that to the rule.

liam: For paging policies: suggestion to change on-call routing so infra pages infra SRE for infra-class alerts (OOMs, node down) and product pages product SRE for latency/slo breaches. Right now both page the same rotation and it doubles noise.

sophia: Is there any resistance from product SRE? We should confirm ownership boundaries before changing routes.

maria: Product SRE (cc @product-sre) signoff required. If no objections in 48h we'll proceed.

aj: Drafted dedupe rule (snippet):
```
alert: GPU_OOM_grouped
expr: count_over_time(gpu_oom{job!="infra-test"}[5m]) > 3
group_by: job_id, model_family
suppress_window: 5m
fallback: region_failure if count(node_down{region="$region"}[10m]) > 0.25 * count(node_total{region="$region"})
```
I'll push to staging and run a dry-run for 24h.

opsbot: deploy-bot posted: staging/alert-rules v1.14 deployed to staging.

maria: Action tracker summary (quick):
- Deduplicate GPU OOMs: owner=aj, dry-run staging 24h, target prod roll = Fri EOD.
- Threshold tuning (non-prod): owner=liam, A/B validate 48h, dashboard by Wed, roll decision after A/B.
- Paging routing change: owner=maria, seek product-sre signoff by +48h, then update routing + runbook.
- Observability: owner=sophia, histogram dashboard by Wed and weekly report first run next Monday.

sophia: I'll add a Prometheus histogram panel and a simple alert if median shifts >20% week-over-week.

liam: For recurring incidents, let's add a monthly sweep: run the incident-heat query and surface top 10 noisy alerts. Owner rotates monthly between infra/product oncall.

maria: Agree. I'll put a recurring calendar invite and a follow-up doc.

remind-bot: reminder set: "confirm product-sre signoff" in 48 hours (at 1841320967).

aj: FYI I'll document the dedupe rationale in the runbook and include rollback steps.

maria: Great — please post links to the staging run and dashboards here when available. If anyone spots regressions during dry-run, flag immediately in this thread and escalate. :exclamation:

liam: Will do. Planning to kick off A/B tonight at 22:00 PDT.

sophia: Adding dashboard link draft: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abc123/gpu-oom-hist - will update after data lands.

maria: Closing loop: next check-in on thread after Fri EOD or sooner if blockers. Thanks all. :rocket:
